zh-CN.heroEyebrow: 为球场而生的 Android 记分牌
zh-CN.heroBody: 篮球记分、比赛计时与比分同步录像，还有一套完整的 2V2 联赛：约上固定队友，从积分赛一路打到冠军争夺。

zh-CN.specLeague: 组队 · 积分 · 以下克上
zh-CN.featuresIntro: 给记分员清晰的数字，也给每场比赛完整的记录。
zh-CN.f1Body: 全场、半场与 2V2。大号比分、加减分和球员犯规，场边操作清楚直接。
zh-CN.f2Body: 正计时、倒计时与节次显示。开始、暂停和重置，跟上比赛的节奏。
zh-CN.f3Body: 半场、2V2 的 12 秒，以及全场 24 秒。最后 6 秒大数字提醒，复位后立即同步。
zh-CN.f4Body: 固定双人组队，积分赛之后开启以下克上挑战，再决出冠军与季军。对阵与赛事路线可导出 JPG。
zh-CN.f5Body: 保存名字和头像，单次或批量管理。选择已有球员和球队，更快开始下一场。
zh-CN.f6Body: 原生摄像、麦克风选择与比分叠加。录制、暂停和计时联动，也能查看最近片段。
zh-CN.recordTitle: 把比赛画面和比分，留在一起。
zh-CN.recordBody: 进入摄像时选择方向与麦克风。在录制界面直接记分，导出的视频顶部保留比分信息。
zh-CN.screensIntro: 记分、组队、赛事与录像，查看实际运行的 Android 界面。

zh-CN.leagueTitle: 约上队友，打出你们的联赛。
zh-CN.leagueIntro: 两人一队，从熟悉的球友开始。先打积分，再向上挑战，最后争夺冠军。把每次约球，变成有排名、有悬念、有结果的一届比赛。
zh-CN.leagueHook: 积分落后，也有以下克上的机会。
zh-CN.leagueStep1Body: 固定双人队友参赛，胜 +2、负 +1。比分与排名随赛果更新，谁在领跑，随时看得见。
zh-CN.leagueStep2Body: 锁榜后，每队有一次连续挑战机会：向前一名发起挑战，赢了继续向上，输了结束。
zh-CN.leagueStep3Body: 挑战结束，锁定最终排名。前两名争冠；参赛队伍足够时，第三、第四名争夺季军。
zh-CN.leaguePractical: 球队与球员档案、场次记录、本机自动保存与备份，以及完整对阵图 / 路线图 JPG 导出，让组织比赛更省心。

en.pageTitle: 闹钟刺客 · Official Android Download
en.metaDescription: Basketball scoring, 12/24-second shot clocks, 2V2 leagues and video with synchronized scores.
en.heroBody: Basketball scoring, game clocks and score-synced video, plus a complete 2V2 league. Team up with a regular partner and play your way from standings to the title game.
en.pendingShort: The APK is not publicly released yet. Download will open here.
en.scoreboardAlt: Actual basketball scoreboard in the white and red theme
en.specShot: Keep the shot clock in sight
en.featuresIntro: Clear numbers for the scorer. A useful record of every game.
en.f1Body: Full court, half court and 2V2. Large scores, quick adjustments and player fouls, within easy reach.
en.f2Body: Count up or down, with period information. Start, pause and reset as the game unfolds.
en.f3Body: 12 seconds for half court and 2V2, 24 for full court. Large final-six-second alerts clear immediately on reset.
en.f4Body: Fixed pairs, league standings, climb-the-ranks challenges and title and bronze games. Export the matchup matrix and tournament route as JPG.
en.f5Body: Keep names and portraits. Add or manage players individually or in batches, then reuse teams next time.
en.f6Body: Native camera capture, microphone selection and score overlays. Recording and pause follow the clock; recent clips are available to review.
en.recordTitle: Keep the play and the score together.
en.recordBody: Choose orientation and microphone before capture. Score directly on the recording screen; exported video keeps the score at the top.
en.screensIntro: Scoring, teams, leagues and recording, captured from the running Android app.
en.g4Body: Capture and score on one screen
en.screenshotNote: Screenshots were captured from v3.4.7 running in an Android emulator with demo players. No generated app screens. Camera previews show emulator test imagery; later versions may differ in detail.
en.demoTitle: From first launch to game day.
en.videoDescription: The tutorial is in production. Watch it here when it is ready.
en.downloadIntro: A free Android APK. Switch between Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English and Japanese in settings.
en.pendingLong: The APK is not yet on GitHub Releases. The version and size shown are from the existing local build; download opens after publication.
en.publishedNote: APK hosted on this repository’s GitHub Releases. Version, size and date come from the published release.
en.change1: v3.4.13 · Fixed score video composition after recording stops.
en.change2: v3.4.13 · Failed jobs no longer block export. Originals and score records are retained for retry.
en.change3: v3.4.13 · Fixed null camera and microphone dialog text and stuck camera startup.
en.copyFailed: Select and copy the checksum above
en.install1: Download the APK, not the GitHub Source code ZIP or TAR archive.
en.install2: Open the APK and follow Android’s prompts to allow installation from the browser you used.
en.install3: Install updates over the existing app. Keep the original installation; you can export an event backup first.
en.author: Created by 土鱼
en.leagueIntro: Start with two-player teams and the people you already play with. Earn points, challenge upward and play for the title. Give your pickup games standings, stakes and a finish.
en.leagueHook: Behind in points? There is still a way up.
en.leagueStep1Body: Play with a fixed partner. A win earns 2 points; a loss earns 1. Scores and standings update as results are recorded.
en.leagueStep2Body: After standings lock, each team gets one challenge run against the team directly above. Win to keep climbing; lose and the run ends.
en.leagueStep3Body: Lock the final order after challenges. The top two play for the title; with enough teams, third and fourth play for bronze.
en.leaguePractical: Team and player profiles, match history, automatic local saves and backups, plus full matchup and tournament-route JPG exports help keep your event organized.
